parameters.prompt: The exact upright crocodile warrior in the reference casts ONE hunting curse in place. From the resting pose it leans forward slightly, raises its right clawed hand and points it ahead toward the left as if marking prey, the jaws opening in a low hiss, then sweeps the pointing hand slowly from one side to the other while keeping the body leaning forward, holds the pose for a moment, then lowers the arm, straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted and the tail stays on the ground. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms, two legs and one tail. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, crocodile head and jaws, scaled skin, armor, belt and kilt. No walking, turning, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, smoke, mist, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: raise and point over the first second, sweep the pointing hand from one to three and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
